notes.title: A Gift for Our Supporters – Get Our New Game for Free
notes.content:
First and most importantly:Anyone who purchased this game before May 22, 2025, is eligible to receive a free activation key for our upcoming game — even if you’ve refunded it!
Simply send us an email, and we’ll send you the key.
(PS: Due to the game’s nature, the key distribution method is a bit old-school. Sorry about that!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549508/dbe0bccc2310088c42b3867718b30b369a127c5a.png[/img]

[h1]Thoughts & Reflections[/h1]

Initially, we aimed to create a story-driven, hyper-realistic 3D sci-fi game.
However, due to limitations in budget, art, and scriptwriting skills, we weren’t able to deliver a fully polished product.
We released it anyway because we didn’t want our efforts to simply fade away — and also in hopes of gaining some feedback and support from players like you.

Thank you so much to every player who gave our game a chance. Your support means a lot to us.

After two months of reflection and research, we’ve realized that while our art and storytelling are weak points, we are much more confident in our programming skills.
So for now, we’ll focus on creating game types that rely less on story and visuals, in hopes of building funds to eventually hire professionals and bring our original vision to life.

As for this casual game, I personally believe it’s at least a “qualified” one. We truly hope this thank-you gift brings you some joy.

Gift keys will be distributed within 1–3 days after the new game is released on Steam.
Expected release date: June 6, 2025.

notes.title: Version 0.3.3 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The initial character spawn location has been changed from the bedroom to the living room, allowing players to see the heroine directly.
[*] Adjusted the camera logic during character movement, removing vertical movement.
[*] Disabled camera control during sex scenes and fixed the camera angle.
[/list]

PS: Happy Labor Day and thank you all for your support! We've discussed the camera control removal for a long time and felt that fixed angles provide a better experience than free movement. Maybe in the future, we'll add a button to switch between fixed and free camera views. Once again, thank you for your continued support.

PS2: In future updates, we plan a complete overhaul of the UI. After that, we will add more story content. You're very welcome to share your feedback with us!

notes.title: Version 0.3.2 Update
notes.content:

notes.title: Version 0.3.0 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a mini-map feature in the bottom-right corner.
[*] Fixed potential bugs related to save files. The save system logic will be rewritten in future versions.
[/list]

PS: Once again, thank you all for your support. We will do our best to fix the issues you've reported and strive to provide a better gaming experience.

notes.title: Version 0.2.1 Update
notes.content:
We have adjusted the sex positions and movements in the living room and on the bed to make them more natural.

PS: Thank you all so much for your support.

We are fully aware that the current version is far from ideal and may even disappoint many. However, we still decided to release this early access version because we were genuinely afraid that, amidst constant revisions and restarts, our already fragile studio wouldn’t survive.

During development, we encountered many unforeseen difficulties, such as the challenges of ultra-realistic style and the complexity of 3D skeletal systems. These significantly increased our workload and pressure. We desperately needed some confidence to keep moving forward.

Fortunately, even just a few purchases and support from players gave us a sense of achievement and strength like never before. Every bit of your attention and encouragement is incredibly precious to us.

We sincerely thank each and every one of you who has supported us.
